release_notes: v4.0.0: Cross-platform Windows + macOS Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) release featuring Metal MPS GPU upscaling, VideoToolbox encoding, Smart Project ZIP & In-Place Folder Clean, Physics Image Guard + 100% Video Cleaning, Extension Show in Folder button, NSPasteboard clipboard, Finder picker, Menu Bar app, and 1-command install.sh / uninstall.sh.
